title: Support custom slugs
body:
Allow `POST /links` to take an optional `slug`.

Rules:
- Valid slugs are 3–32 characters of `A-Z a-z 0-9 _ -`.
- The reserved words `api` and `links` are not allowed.
- Invalid slug → `400`.
- Slug already in use → `409`.
- Otherwise create the link with that slug → `201`, and `GET /<slug>` redirects to it.
